title: Welcome to SurgicGuide, Chan Kin-lun!
html:
We are delighted to welcome Chan Kin-lun to SurgicGuide Limited as our new Intern. We look forward to supporting his development, fostering new ideas, and working together as we continue to advance innovation in precision cancer surgery.

SurgicGuide Limited

Advancing Precision. Guiding Surgery. Improving Outcomes.
